title: Eval gold flywheel: findings and annotations
description: Track agent-proposed eval gold until a human accepts it. Findings name one expected detection (stay proposed until a person advances them). Annotations name one fixture labeling pass (stay awaiting-review until a person accepts them). Do not file five layer sub-tasks per finding; decompose in findings/<id>/decomposition.md.
